sections.changelog:
5.1.2 - 25 August, 2025

  • Improvement: Action Scheduler as the new background processing library for broader compatibility
  • Improvement: Cache static assets separately in Cloduflare integration
  • Improvement: Used CSS generation is faster than before
  • Improvement: Upgrade some dependencies for enhanced performance
  • Improvement: Default delay between each preload is 0.5s
  • Improvement: Default timeout for loading scripts is now 10s
  • Removed: Disable WP Cron is permanently removed from the bloat settings
  • Fix: Critical images were incorrectly detected in certain cases

Full changelog: flyingpress.com/changelog
